# Psalm 142 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 142:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** A-maskil of-David when-he-was in-the-cave. A-prayer. With-my-voice to-YHWH I-cry; with-my-voice to-YHWH I-plead.
- **LOGOS:** A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. With my voice I cry out to the LORD; with my voice I plead for mercy to the LORD.
- **PNEUMA:** A contemplative prayer of David, written when he was hiding in a cave. I cry out to the LORD at the top of my voice; I beg the LORD for mercy out loud.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 142:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** I-pour-out before-him my-complaint; my-distress before-him I-declare.
- **LOGOS:** I pour out my complaint before him; I tell my trouble before him.
- **PNEUMA:** I pour out all my complaints in front of him; I lay all my troubles before him.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 142:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Attend to-my-cry for I-am-brought-very-low; deliver-me from-my-persecutors, for they-are-too-strong for-me.
- **LOGOS:** Attend to my cry, for I am brought very low! Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me!
- **PNEUMA:** Pay attention to my cry — I'm completely desperate! Rescue me from my pursuers — they're stronger than I am!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 142:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Bring-out from-prison my-soul, to-give-thanks to-your-name; around-me will-crown the-righteous, for you-will-deal-bountifully with-me.
- **LOGOS:** Bring me out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name! The righteous will surround me, for you will deal bountifully with me.
- **PNEUMA:** Free me from this prison so I can praise your name! The righteous will gather around me when you show me your generosity.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 142:3 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** When-faints upon-me my-spirit, and-you know my-path. In-the-way which I-walk they-have-hidden a-trap for-me.
- **LOGOS:** When my spirit faints within me, you know my way! In the path where I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
- **PNEUMA:** When I'm about to collapse, you know the path I'm on. They've hidden a trap right where I walk.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 142:4 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** Look to-the-right and-see — there-is-no for-me one-recognizing; has-perished refuge from-me; there-is-no one-caring for my-soul.
- **LOGOS:** Look to the right and see: there is none who takes notice of me; no refuge remains to me; no one cares for my soul.
- **PNEUMA:** Look around me — no one even notices me. I have nowhere to run. Not a single person cares what happens to me.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
